# nxos_platform (Resource)

This resource can manage the platform configuration on NX-OS devices, including hardware profiles, TCAM regions, NVE platform settings, and extended platform entity configuration.

### API Documentation

- [platformEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/System/platform%3AEntity/)

- [platformNVE](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/System/platform%3ANVE/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nxos_platform" "example" {
  nve_interfaces = {
    "1" = {
      ipmc_index_size = 4000
      infra_vlans = {
        "100" = {
          force = "Enable"
        }
      }
    }
  }
  extended_dme_load_interval              = 300
  port_channel_load_balance_concatenation = "enable"
  port_channel_load_balance_fields        = "srcDstIp"
  port_channel_load_balance_rotate        = 3
  port_channel_load_balance_symmetry      = "enable"
  pfc_watchdog_auto_restore_multiplier    = 20
  pfc_watchdog_mode                       = "on"
  pfc_watchdog_fixed_restore_multiplier   = 50
  pfc_watchdog_interval                   = 200
  pfc_watchdog_shutdown_multiplier        = 5
  qos_burst_detect_fall_threshold_unit    = "percentage"
  qos_burst_detect_fall_threshold         = 40
  qos_burst_detect_rise_threshold_unit    = "percentage"
  qos_burst_detect_rise_threshold         = 60
  qos_classify_ns_only                    = "Enabled"
  qos_cpu_size                            = 300
  qos_drop_pool_size                      = 10
  qos_headroom_size                       = 10
  qos_include_ipg                         = "Enabled"
  qos_lcpu_size                           = 300
  qos_nodrop_dynamic_queue_limit          = 10
  qos_nodrop_resume_offset                = 10
  qos_nodrop_pool_size                    = 10
  qos_pfc_static                          = "Enabled"
  qos_pg_headroom_reserve                 = 50
  qos_pg_min_value                        = 5
  qos_pg_no_min                           = false
  qos_pg_share                            = "Disabled"
  tcam_templates = {
    "TPL1" = {
      reference_template = "l3"
      udfs = {
        "racl;UDF1" = {}
      }
    }
  }
  udf_description = "My UDFs"
  udfs = {
    "UDF1" = {
      mpls_stack_1    = true
      mpls_stack_2    = true
      netflow_rtp     = true
      offset_base     = "outer-header-l3"
      offset_length   = 2
      offset_position = 10
      qualify_racl    = true
    }
  }
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = nxos_platform.example
  identity = {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema


#### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform's `import` block requires a non-empty `id` value, so this format cannot be used to
# import nxos_platform for the default device. Use the `terraform import` command
# below, or identity-based import shown above, instead.
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nxos_platform.example ""
```
